description: exp_g_0022 - exp_g_0021_smallE_concat_readout_noutdecomp with ONE change: v_lut output width d_v 16 -> 64, so each of the 6 attention heads carries a 64-wide value again (q/k were already 64). v_lut is CompressionMultiHeadLUTMH with multihead_output=True and inner_out_dim=-1, so its output_dim IS the emitted width: [N, 48 routing mini-heads, 64] instead of [N, 48, 16]. CONSEQUENCE, derived automatically by train.py: out_proj's input_dim is H*d_v, which grows 6*16=96 -> 6*64=384. out_proj is otherwise unchanged (inner_in=48, inner_out=-1 so no decompress and the 8 routing heads are summed, tph=128, n_heads=8, output_dim=E=64). The READOUT path is unaffected: each layer still emits E=64 into the stream, so the 6-layer concatenation stays 384 wide and the readout LUT's input_dim is unchanged -- v width is internal to attention. Everything else identical to exp_g_0021. Shared lutorch NOT modified.
